# Example Site

> The clean control fixture for the web-discoverability-skill benchmark. Every
> link below is an absolute HTTPS URL, which is what the llms.txt checks require.

## Pages

- [Home](https://example.com/): what the fixture is for.
- [About](https://example.com/about): who maintains it.
- [Hello](https://example.com/blog/hello): the only article.
